hlslLsp.general.fileExtensions.title: HLSL file extensions
hlslLsp.general.fileExtensions.description: Semicolon-separated file extensions to treat as HLSL. The built-in .hlsl and .hlsli extensions are always supported.

hlslLsp.general.languageVersion.title: Default HLSL language version
hlslLsp.general.languageVersion.description: The default DXC -HV value. A shadertoolsconfig.json languageVersion setting takes precedence.

hlslLsp.general.dxcRuntimeDirectory.title: DXC runtime directory
hlslLsp.general.dxcRuntimeDirectory.description: Directory containing a compatible DXC runtime (dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll) to load instead of the bundled one. An explicit value overrides shadertoolsconfig.json. Empty uses the bundled runtime. Changing it restarts the language server.

hlslLsp.general.inlayHintParameters.title: Parameter-name hints
hlslLsp.general.inlayHintParameters.description: Show unambiguous overload parameter-name hints at call sites.

hlslLsp.general.inlayHintMatrixOrientati.title: Matrix orientation hints
hlslLsp.general.inlayHintMatrixOrientati.description: Show compiler-derived row-major or column-major matrix orientation hints.

hlslLsp.general.inlayHintRegisters.title: Resource register hints
hlslLsp.general.inlayHintRegisters.description: Show reflected resource register and space hints.

hlslLsp.general.inlayHintActiveVariant.title: Active variant hints
hlslLsp.general.inlayHintActiveVariant.description: Show the selected compilation variant where it affects the current shader.
